ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What do plants carry through their stem?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the picture there is the stem and leaves of a green plant; inside the stem there is a blue channel/flow line extending upward, and it continues into the leaves. Beside the stem there is a red arrow pointing to this internal blue channel. The picture also shows the sun shining toward the leaves, as well as red wavy arrows near the leaves. Reasoning: The question asks what the plant transports through the stem. In a plant transport schematic diagram, blue usually indicates water moving in the stem toward the leaves. Therefore, what the plant transports through the stem is water.
